field.name: event_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_EVENTREPORT_REQUEST_ITEM_LABEL
field.query: SELECT m.id AS value, CONCAT(p.name, ' - ', r.name, ' #', m.id) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_match AS m INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project AS p ON p.id = m.project_id INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project_round AS r ON r.id = m.round_id WHERE m.published = 1 AND p.published = 1 ORDER BY m.scheduled_start DESC, m.id DESC
